declarations.name: Bar
declarations.description: Carries the LIST form of an `attrTypes` enum override, plus the CEM enum whose token pool it must REUSE.

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description: A CEM-classified enum. It mints the `auto` token, which the config overrides below must REUSE rather than re-mint — a duplicate identifier in the Values module is a deliberate hard COLLISION error.

attributes.name: disable-pagination
attributes.description: The CEM types this as a free string; config constrains it to three values with the LIST form of `attrTypes`. This is the regression: it shipped as `String -> Attr` with no union row and no Values tokens.

attributes.name: max-visible
attributes.description: The `AEnumNum` shape — a number OR a keyword. Emits a plain `String` setter, because HtmlIr.Value's phantom row is over string TOKENS and has no numeric member. Pinned here so the degradation is deliberate rather than incidental.

declarations.name: Gate
declarations.description: Carries the MAP form of an `attrTypes` enum override — the form whose whole point is that the Elm token name differs from the string it writes.

attributes.name: strict
attributes.description: The CEM types this as a free string; config constrains it with the MAP form of `attrTypes`, so `always` writes "true" and `never` writes "false".
